rule_text.name: 702.294a
rule_text.rule: Siphon is a static ability that functions while the spell with siphon is on the stack. “Siphon” means “For each generic mana in this spell’s total cost, you may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control with toughness 1 or greater and less damage marked on it than its total toughness rather than pay that mana.”

rule_text.name: 702.294b
rule_text.rule: Multiple instances of siphon on the same spell are redundant.
